Markets.title: BSE launches 3-day SLB contracts to boost short-term securities borrowing
Markets.summary: BSE Clearing has launched three-working-day securities lending and borrowing contracts to provide market participants with short-term flexibility. Effective August 17, these contracts initially cover futures and options securities under the D-series prefix.

Markets.summary: Global markets are focusing on food and energy inflation, US consumer spending, Japan's growth outlook, gold prices, and UK inflation this week. Investors will watch these five triggers to determine if rising costs will complicate central bank interest rate decisions.

Markets.title: Emerging markets defy global shocks as investors return to local assets
Markets.summary: Despite global risks, emerging markets are attracting strong foreign investment into their debt due to improved policymaking and deeper domestic markets. However, equities continue to struggle, causing investors to be more selective.

Markets.title: BSE shares tumble 5% after Jefferies downgrades stock to Underperform. Here’s why
Markets.summary: BSE shares dropped 5% on Monday after Jefferies downgraded the stock to Underperform and reduced its target price to Rs 2,940. The brokerage cited potential risks from proprietary trading, regulatory changes, and lower earnings estimates despite strong Q1 results.

Markets.title: Alibaba Earnings: Can AI bets power the next growth wave?
Markets.summary: Alibaba's upcoming second-quarter earnings will reveal if its heavy AI investments and strong cloud growth can offset falling profitability. The results and associated legal risks will determine the future direction of the company's recent stock rally.

Geo-Political.title: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump's son-in-law and envoy, Jared Kushner, arrived in Israel following rare talks with Hamas concerning a Gaza peace plan. Kushner is scheduled to meet with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu later on Monday.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian strikes killed six people and injured a 14-year-old child in Russia. The acting governor of the Russian Belgorod region reported these casualties.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced a reduction in U.S. military drills with South Korea. He cited his strong relationship with North Korea's leader and South Korea's absence from the Iran conflict as reasons for the decision.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
Geo-Political.summary: The current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is now the deadliest in the country's history. This epidemic is driven by a rare and fast-growing strain of the virus known as Bundibugyo.

Geo-Political.title: Record rains drench South Korean city as landslide kills one
Geo-Political.summary: Record rainfall has drenched a South Korean city, causing a landslide that killed one person. This disaster is part of a broader weather pattern bringing heavy downpours to large areas of East and Southeast Asia.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, price increases accelerated for both primary articles, rising 8.52%, and manufactured products, rising 8.29%.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India’s merchandise trade deficit widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% year-on-year to $173.78 billion.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase matched analyst expectations and could provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding interest rates.

India.title: Gujarat Cop Quits Over Jantar Mantar Protest To Support PM Modi For 2029 Polls
India.summary: A Gujarat police constable resigned following a protest at Jantar Mantar to support Prime Minister Narendra Modi in the 2029 elections. Gosai also vowed to remain barefoot until Modi returns to power in 2029.

India.title: 5 Years On The Run, Gujarat BJP Worker Arrested In Liquor Case
India.summary: Gujarat police have arrested fugitive BJP worker Mukesh alias Tina Pargi after he spent five years on the run. Pargi was wanted in connection with an illegal liquor case.

India.title: 'Not Supernatural': Officials Clarify As 600 Girls Leave Maharashtra Hostel
India.summary: Authorities investigated an incident where 600 girls left a Maharashtra hostel after six students displayed symptoms like persistent crying, fear, and physical pain. Officials clarified that the situation was not supernatural.
